description: Create a real estimate case through the public router. Reuses the connection X-Agent-Key (get one free with POST https://astranl.com/api/agents/register; the api_key is shown once; send it as the X-Agent-Key header of the MCP connection); requester_kind is agent. Save case_id and token securely. language selects human-client output, default nl. Duplicates do not return a token. Processing may be asynchronous.
name: estimate_case_create
